notes: Boards in pieces: on 7 admissible pairs the oracle's satake raises AssertionError (from its BC and two-length branches of classify_restricted), not the ValueError named in decisions/P6-A1.md and in P6-A1's report. Examples: A2+A2 X=[] tau=[0,1,3,2], A1+A2 X=[] tau=[0,2,1], G2+A1 X=[] identity, A3+A1 X=[1] tau=[2,1,0,3]. The engine throws NeedsConnectedBoard. Both refuse, so this is not a finding. Attack 1, caps below the number of seeds (reseeded search harness, triangle with 3 seeds at cap 1 and 2): the oracle stops with AssertionError and the engine throws RangeError. SPEC 5.5 does not define this case; it belongs to RT-03 and RT-10 (lens section 6).

The owner-held P3-RT-01-01 (symbolicPlay on Big boards throws EngineOverflow where symbolic_play answers) still reproduces at f07eec6, unchanged. The refuted P5-RT-01-01 (formIsInvariant gives RangeError on a form entry beyond 2^53) also behaves as before.

The engine's Satake functions compute a hand-built Big board on a private SafeInt copy, so a population entry beyond 2^53 throws EngineOverflow. The contract types the result as number[], and decisions/P6-A1.md records this. Noted, not a finding.

Process: I ran the phase 5 reproducers by checking them out into the worktree for the run only. A first checkout overwrote 10 tracked test files with the phase 5 branch's versions; I restored them from f07eec6 at once, before running anything, and nothing of that was committed. The committed files are new files named redteam-RT-01-p6-*. Twice I ran a shell command with cd or a multi-line inline script, against the shell rule; it had no effect on the results.
The shared machine was loaded throughout (load average 16 to 41 on 4 processors). The site build took 21 minutes. No timing was measured or reported.
